summary: tests/test_wordbase_audio_cmd.py: 5/22 fail from a clean tree on any branch. tools/wordbase_audio_cmd.py + its tests date to 2026-07-24; glyph_isa_v2.py was rewritten 2026-09-07/08 by GH-8b/GH-16/GH-17 and the tool was never updated.
root_cause: Since GH-8b/GH-16/GH-17, GlyphCPUv2 stores to non-FS-window, non-MMIO addresses land in self.memory (shadow RAM), NOT the image ndarray. tools/wordbase_audio_cmd.py execute_glyph_assembly() (line ~183) reads back via cpu._mem_read(image, 500) which reads the image pixels -> always 0. Minimal repro: asm ['LDI r1 500','LDI r2 255','ST r1 r2','HALT'] on a 200-col image -> cpu.memory[500]==255 but _mem_read(image,500)==0.
suggested_fix_options: A (minimal, preserves intent): execute_glyph_assembly reads back cpu.memory[500] (shadow RAM) instead of _mem_read(image, ...) — matches where GH-16/17 stores actually land.
B (if image-pixel persistence is the intent): route addr 500 through the GH-8b FS pixel window (_fs_pix_write), but that changes the memory map contract and needs GH-18 track sign-off.
constraint: tools/glyph_isa_v2.py is GH-18-track-owned; fix belongs in tools/wordbase_audio_cmd.py readback (option A) or a coordinated change. Also note: full-suite runs with system python3 hit ModuleNotFoundError librosa (2 collection errors: test_frequency_mapper.py, test_griffin_lim.py) — pre-existing, unrelated.
verification_evidence: GH-19 branch clean tree: tests/test_gh19_stdlib.py 27/27 pass; tests/test_gh*.py 150/150 pass in 29.87s (matches 'GH-19 complete' commit receipt).
